tests.scope_note: Completed before final cited-message isolation and standalone GUI correlation refinements; both refinements were covered by subsequent final focused runs.

invariants_verified: continue/regenerate/wait use strict actions, reasons and supplied evidence
only cited relevant messages are merged; unrelated messages remain independent
burst traffic and judge failure release unsent output instead of starving it
two judgments, one regeneration and two seconds total hold per durable logical reply
late and stale judgments cannot undo loose release or a valid explicit wait
restart preserves deadline/quota and restores verified partial delivery prefix
same-reply regeneration does not trip independent-reply cooldown
group and private modes are independent and preserve send/attention/unknown-delivery fences
pause then resume does not revive a pre-control reply
judgments do not require main generation lock and stop admitting work during maintenance
expired queued judgments do not call the provider; in-flight workers retain concurrency slots
HTTP judgment requests have no automatic transport retry
Runtime UI finals require authorized delivery; per-run bubbles preserve later user messages
Runtime and standalone GUI both honor client-created correlation IDs
remaining_release_validation: Observe actual-model JSON validity, interruption precision, latency and cost in shadow mode
Measure natural-language duplication of already delivered prefixes before wider activation
